name: Burn
why: Kept: Burn is the burst caster's fuel (two stacks at once).

name: Quench
meaning: put fire out, and cash the heat in
why: Kept: cashing heat in is half of a burst caster's loop.

name: Ignite
meaning: start a fire at a point
why: Kept: the cheap way to start a burn and get hot.

name: Snuff
meaning: put out one flame or source at once
why: Kept: fire's one hard interrupt; the utility side, so a caster is not helpless against a big wind-up.

name: Explode
effect: reach x1.3; power x1.15; cost x1.15
why: Kept: the payoff verb. Explode now also names the burst caster's dearer, heavier tier.

name: Implode
why: Kept: the inward draw that sets up a point-blank burst.

name: Blaze
why: Kept: building heat hard and fast.

name: Smoulder
why: Kept: the burn that lasts, so a burst has something to cash in.

name: Flare
why: Kept: Dazed (+50% taken) is a burst set-up as much as a flash.

name: Smother
meaning: starve a fire, or a foe, of air
why: Kept: smoke is fire's cover against archers, and it now banks burns for the burst.

name: Catch
meaning: fire leaps from a burning body to every body near it
why: Added for 'spreading burns', half of the role, which no rune said outright: Burn and Ignite start a fire on one body, Blaze spreads it in front of you, but nothing made a burn leap from body to body. A branch (spreads or splits), drawing outward (-0.8, as Blaze). As a modifier its hit jumps on, as Lightning's Arc does: Catch is the parent concept Arc grows from.

name: Sear
meaning: drive all the heat into one point: white-hot
why: Added for 'big hits': the one big, single, heat-scaled blow a burst caster is built round. A cap (ends a structure: everything goes into it), drawing inward (+0.7, as Quench). Base beats universal on its own ground: it is a stronger Focus (power x1.3; reach x0.8).
